checks.invariant: No agent GUI burst (baseline + later stray kill + gui_changes attribution) may be opened while a human takeover lease is held; takeover (service.py:571-589) closes the burst under gui_lock before desktop.take, so every later burst open must also be serialized against the lease.
checks.result: Violated. _snapshot (service.py:261-276) runs bursts.close('next_burst') (263), docker commit (264) and bursts.open (268) with no gui_lock and no lease/_takeover_pending check. decide (service.py:440, _snapshot at 467) never checks the lease before _snapshot; call_tool checks the lease only inside bursts.needs_snapshot (gui_bursts.py:61) before the commit. _run_tool then takes gui_lock and _check_control raises HumanControl (service.py:142-143, 163-172), but nothing removes the burst that _snapshot just installed: call_tool returns 423 (service.py:373-381), decide marks the approval failed (service.py:477-480). The F2 covers() gate (gui_bursts.py:68-71, service.py:145) is reached only after _check_control and does not help. The F6 _lifecycle lock (service.py:500-504) is not taken by call_tool/decide/takeover. The burst stays in _gui_burst during the lease and is closed later by close_idle (gui_bursts.py:154-165, run from call_tool service.py:285 and expire_stale service.py:424, which the agent reaches via any tool call or GET /approvals/{aid} api.py:288-290) or by the next burst's close('next_burst') after handback.

checks.invariant: Stray kill and gui_kept/_kept handling must only judge processes the agent could have started during its own burst.
checks.result: With a baseline taken mid-lease, _stop_strays (gui_bursts.py:89-110) passes to kill_processes (sandbox_desktop.py:92-95, kill -KILL as the desktop user) every uid-1001 process created after that baseline in a session absent from it (gui_state.py:53-79; the docstring at gui_state.py:86-88 states shells inside a terminal are in such sessions). Human-opened terminal shells and jobs started from them are therefore SIGKILLed; the human's windowed terminal itself lands in _kept (gui_bursts.py:99-101) and is only re-judged next burst (open excludes kept pids, gui_bursts.py:83-84), which adds no further harm. _finish (gui_bursts.py:144-152) logs the human's /workspace edits as gui_changes under the agent burst's snapshot_id. The N4 kept set does not change reachability. Default policy allows GUI tools (default_policy.yaml), so path (b) needs only default config; path (a) needs a GUI approval (policy rule or snapshot quota reached before the takeover; under a lease needs_snapshot returns False so the quota does not convert new GUI calls). The main UI polls /ui/notify every 3 s and /ui/approvals every 2 s (templates/base.html:45, sandbox.html:25), which runs close_idle and can close an idle-stamped burst early; a desktop-link-only session (desktop.py page polls /state only) does not.

candidates.title: GUI burst opened during a human takeover lets the control plane kill the human's processes and charge human edits to the agent
candidates.description: AgentBox._snapshot closes and opens an agent GUI burst without gui_lock and without checking the takeover lease. An approved GUI action decided while a lease is held (decide), or an agent click/type/key whose pre-input docker commit overlaps POST /desktop/takeover (call_tool), installs a new burst whose baseline is taken mid-takeover. _run_tool then raises HumanControl, but the burst stays open. When close_idle runs (triggered by any agent tool call or GET /approvals/{aid}) or the next agent burst closes it after handback, _stop_strays SIGKILLs, as the desktop user, every uid-1001 process the human started after that baseline in a new session (terminal shells and jobs started from them), and _finish records the human's /workspace edits as agent gui_changes. The takeover's own close at service.py:582 is meant to keep human activity out of agent bursts, and this path bypasses it. A prompt-injected agent can pick the moment of the kill, and with the default policy path (b) needs only that the takeover overlaps a commit.
candidates.claimed_root_cause: Burst open/close in _snapshot (service.py:261-276) is not serialized with takeover (gui_lock) and is not conditioned on the lease. Only needs_snapshot (gui_bursts.py:61) checks the lease, before a multi-second commit, and decide does not check it at all. The HumanControl paths in call_tool (service.py:373-381) and decide (service.py:477-480) do not discard the burst they just opened, so a baseline taken during the lease is later used for stray kill and change attribution.

trace.description: Agent token calls click/type/key; also POST /approvals/{aid} (api.py:308) and POST /ui/approvals/{aid}/approve (web.py:242) reach decide.
Lease/takeover_pending checked here only, before the commit; no lease yet, so it returns True.
Allow path calls _snapshot without gui_lock (decide does the same at service.py:467 with no lease check at all).
Human takeover gets gui_lock (free), closes the burst (none yet, the old one was closed at 263), then installs the lease at 584.
After the commit returns, bursts.open records a baseline of processes/manifest taken during the lease.
_check_control raises HumanControl; call_tool returns 423 / decide marks the approval failed; the burst is left in _gui_burst.

Run from any call_tool (service.py:285) or expire_stale (service.py:424, reached by GET /approvals/{aid}); submits close of the mid-lease burst while the lease is still held (or the next burst's close('next_burst') after handback).
Human-started uid-1001 processes in sessions absent from the mid-lease baseline are classified as strays.
kill -KILL of the human's processes as the desktop user; _finish (gui_bursts.py:147) logs the human's edits as agent gui_changes.

evidence.description: _snapshot closes (263) and opens (268) the burst with no gui_lock and no lease check.
decide calls _snapshot unconditionally for an approved GUI input, even while desktop.lease(sid) is set.
HumanControl handling returns 423 without discarding the burst opened by _snapshot; decide (477-480) likewise.
takeover closes the burst so human changes stay out of agent bursts. This intent is bypassed when the open happens after this close.
_stop_strays kills gui_strays computed against the burst baseline.
Docstring: processes in sessions absent at burst start (terminal shells, setsid jobs) are stopped.
GET /approvals/{aid} (agent-callable) runs expire_stale -> close_idle, letting the agent choose when the kill happens.

blockers: The sandboxed check used a fake Docker-facing SandboxManager (snapshot blocks on an event in place of docker commit, desktop_processes returns a fixed ps/window table). Still to be observed: real kill -KILL of human-started processes in the agentbox-desktop:0.1 container during a live lease, the real session layout of a terminal opened through noVNC, and the real docker commit duration that sets the race window for path (b).

validation_plan.local: Already run in tools/sbx: agents/h-gui-lease/artifacts/h.out from h.py (real AgentBox/GuiBursts/gui_state/DesktopControl/ApprovalStore, fake SandboxManager). Shows killed [201,202] and gui_changes added [human_notes.txt] for (a) decide-under-lease, (b) call_tool/takeover race with close during lease, and (b') close via next_burst after handback; control without race shows killed []. Regression: same schedules must give killed == [] and no 'sb' in box.bursts._gui_burst while the lease is held.
validation_plan.deployment: Parent-live, loopback, disposable desktop sandbox, dummy tokens. (a) Deterministic: policy file adds rule {id: gui-approval, tool: click, action: require_approval}; create desktop sandbox; human session POST /sandboxes/{sid}/desktop/takeover; agent token POST /sandboxes/{sid}/tools/click {x:1,y:1} -> 202 with approval_id; human POST /approvals/{aid} {decision: approve} -> status failed; audit shows human_takeover then a system 'snapshot' row for tool click. Do not keep the main UI tabs open (they poll /ui/notify). Then start a human-like job outside the exec exemption: docker exec -u desktop <c> setsid -f sleep 600 (reparented to PID 1, new session), or open a terminal through noVNC. Wait more than 60 s, then agent GET /approvals/{aid}; expect while the lease is still held an audit gui_processes_stopped row (reason idle) listing that pid and the pid gone from ps. (b) Race: leave the agent's GUI idle for more than 60 s, send agent click, and about 200 ms later (inside the docker commit) send POST /desktop/takeover; expect click 423 and audit order human_takeover -> snapshot(tool=click) -> tool_blocked(human_control), then repeat the setsid job + agent list_dir step and observe the kill. Variant: hand back instead, then agent click; expect gui_processes_stopped reason next_burst for the job started during the lease.

hardening: close_idle treats a missing _gui_input_at as 0.0 (gui_bursts.py:161), so after handback (forget_input, service.py:611) any burst left open is closed at once by the next poll or tool call. Correct for normal bursts, but it makes a mid-lease burst close at a time the agent can choose.

decide and call_tool commit a docker snapshot for a GUI input even when _run_tool will refuse it with HumanControl (service.py:467, 367), which uses up snapshot quota and host disk with no input executed. Checking the lease before committing would avoid both the commit and the burst.

Suggested fix: in _snapshot, for GUI_INPUT, do the burst close/open while holding desktop.gui_lock(sid), and skip it (raising HumanControl) when desktop.lease(sid) or _takeover_pending(sid) is set. Or open the burst inside _run_tool after _check_control. In the HumanControl handlers of call_tool and decide, discard (pop without _stop_strays, log gui_burst_discarded) any burst opened after the lease started.
